# Review Heatmap

`anki-review-heatmap.js`, `d3.min.js` and the `heatmap-*.svg` images under
`qt/aqt/data/web/imgs/` come from the Review Heatmap add-on for Anki,
version 1.0.1, by Aristotelis P. (Glutanimate),
https://github.com/glutanimate/review-heatmap, licensed under the GNU
AGPLv3 (the same licence as Clanki). The Python side of the port lives in
`qt/aqt/review_heatmap.py`.

The JS bundle contains:

- cal-heatmap v3.6.3.2-anki by Wan Qi Chen, MIT licence,
  https://github.com/glutanimate/cal-heatmap
- d3.js v3.5.17 by Mike Bostock, BSD licence, https://d3js.org/

The navigation and settings icons are from the add-on's `web/assets/` (see its
`LICENSE.md`: CC BY 4.0 icons by the add-on author).
